name: Prashkovsky Investments and Construction Ltd.
summary: Prashkovsky Investments and Construction Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in the initiation, planning, construction, marketing, and sale of residential and commercial properties in Israel and the United States. It operates through Housing for Rent in Israel; Real Estate for Investment in the USA; Commercial Buildings in Israel; and Entrepreneurial Real Estate in Israel. The company's property portfolio includes residential apartments, offices, and commercial spaces. It also leases houses. Prashkovsky Investments and Construction Ltd. was incorporated in 2006 and is based in Rishon LeZion, Israel.
